name: launa
description: Manage Launa paid APIs from the agent: wrap endpoints, set x402 prices, inspect 402s, and review settlements.

LAUNA_API_KEY.title: Launa API key
LAUNA_API_KEY.description: Scoped seller API key. Leave empty for wallet-free inspection.

LAUNA_EVM_PRIVATE_KEY.title: EVM signing key (optional)
LAUNA_EVM_PRIVATE_KEY.description: Only for explicitly authorized paid API requests. Enter in secure plugin settings, never chat.

HEDERA_ACCOUNT_ID.title: Hedera account (optional)
HEDERA_ACCOUNT_ID.description: Account used only for authorized paid API requests.

HEDERA_PRIVATE_KEY.title: Hedera signing key (optional)
HEDERA_PRIVATE_KEY.description: Only for explicitly authorized paid API requests. Enter in secure plugin settings, never chat.
